style.prompt: Create a square social media image, warm and simple: a small ceramic espresso cup with rich espresso and delicate visible curls of steam on a sunny café table. Golden morning sunlight, soft natural shadows, warm cream and caramel palette, uncluttered composition, inviting realistic lifestyle photography. Leave clean negative space for a beautifully legible headline, rendered exactly: “Small cup. Big energy.” Use tasteful bold clean typography, dark warm brown, clear hierarchy and generous margins. The headline is the ONLY text anywhere in the image. No other text, no logos, no watermarks, no signage or lettering on the cup. Polished minimalist social graphic.
